name: Grasim Industries Ltd
title: Grasim Industries Ltd - 500300 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Grasim's Q4 FY26 story is paints and Pivot scaling with losses still heavy; capacity discipline is absent (Lyocell and caustic expansion, 110k tpa Lyocell), and Opus price hikes face elasticity risk after 20-25% COGS inflation.

capex.quote: we have already announced expansion of our cellulosic fiber business where at Harihar we are adding capacity of Lyocell of 110,000 tons per annum

triggers.label: Opus price hikes in Q1 FY27
triggers.quote: In April 2026, Birla Opus announced its second and third phase of price increase to offset the raised input cost.

triggers.label: Input costs 20-25% of COGS
triggers.quote: spiraling of cost of goods to as high as 20% to 25% of COGS and we are still counting the impact

triggers.label: Pivot EBITDA breakeven by FY27 exit
triggers.quote: Our goal for this financial year FY27 is to exit with EBITDA break-even

triggers.label: Industry to double-digit growth FY27
triggers.quote: the industry is likely to move from a single-digit growth to a double-digit growth in FY 27

guidance.value: INR8,500 crore guidance; in striking distance
guidance.quote: This business is in a striking distance away from our annual revenue guidance of INR8,500 crores.

guidance.value: INR10,000 crore profitable revenue in third year of full-scale operations
guidance.quote: we steer business towards guided INR 10,000 crores profitable revenue in the third year of full-scale operations
Our goal for this financial year FY27 is to exit with EBITDA break-even
Capex guidance for 2027 we will be able to share you next quarter.

prior_guidance_check.quote: This business is in a striking distance away from our annual revenue guidance of INR8,500 crores.

red_flags.label: Paints losses ~INR3bn pre-tax per quarter
red_flags.quote: you have been clocking three billion pre-tax losses every quarter for the last few quarters

red_flags.label: Price hikes into elastic demand
red_flags.quote: its impact on medium-term consumer demand remains uncertain as demand elasticity curve will be fully tested in this period

evasions.quote: I think we have stopped disclosing this several couple of years ago.
I hope it's clear. The numbers that are quoted, we have internal estimates
